text:
Dmitri: FYI, ap-southeast1 is showing a weird pile-up: ~150 GPU pods Pending since the midnight rollout. Theyre mostly stuck waiting on prebind/taint handoff and attach.
Infra-bot: alert: cluster gpu-prod-ap-southeast1 pending_pods=152 severity=warning dashboard=https://console/reports/alerts/1740509999
Alice: Seen. Eviction noise in the morning too. Did the prebind-window change land?
Ben: I rolled prebind-window from 3s -> 8s to cut latebind rates under load. Looks like it increases prebind wait times when taint-propagation is slow in this region.
Carla: Can we do a quick mitigation? Either revert prebind or revert to region-safe defaults. We need to stop the churn.
Dmitri: Ops-SRE, please start a targeted rollback in ap-southeast1 (a/b/c). Keep blast radius minimal.
Ops-SRE: Starting rollback canary to ap-southeast1a now (1730510005). Will follow with b/c if green.
Ben: Pasting a few snippets from scheduler and kubelet logs:
```
I0401 00:12:12 scheduler.go:prebind wait=7900ms pod=ml-train-xyz node=gpux-apse1c-09
W0401 00:12:14 attach: nvattach queue full, backpressure=high
E0401 00:12:17 prebind: taint-prop delay node=gpux-apse1c-07 dur=9.2s
```
Carla: Also seeing conntrack timeouts on attach and kubelet mount concurrency hitting limits. Propose bumping attach-concurrency from 3 -> 10 temporarily in apac to reduce timeouts.
Dmitri: Good call. Let's rollback prebind first, then roll the attach-concurrency canary (10% nodes) before full.
Infra-bot: deploybot: rollback initiated by Ops-SRE at 1740510030 for ap-southeast1a,b,c.
Alice: After the first canary (a), pending dropped ~150 -> 70 in about 90s. Promising.
Ops-SRE: Canary completed for a/b/c at 1740510110. Monitoring metrics.
Dmitri: Rolling attach-concurrency canary to 10% of nodes in ap-southeast1 now.
Ben: After both changes, pending decreased to ~20 within 4 minutes. Eviction churn stopped. Short-term mitigated.
Carla: Raising follow-up: prebind heuristics need per-region safety checks. apac taint/conntrack latencies are higher; aggressive prebind amplifies waiting pods. Filing ticket.
Dmitri: I'll draft the postmortem and RFC. We should consider tying prebind-window to region telemetry (e.g., 95th percentile taint-prop). Also add a scheduler rollout guard that skips aggressive prebind in regions with known attach/backpressure.
Ben: Long-term idea: fallback to latebind when nvlink/attach backpressure > threshold, or dynamically tune prebind-window based on observed attach success rate.
Alice: Add a cost estimate in the postmortem for the extra queued pods and failed attaches (GPU-hours idle + re-schedules).
Dmitri: Agreed. I'll include metrics: pending counts, attach latency, prebind wait distribution, and eviction count delta. Posting draft RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/prebind-region-safety (WIP).
Infra-bot: incident status -> mitigated at 1740510248. Keep monitoring dashboard: https://console/infra/metrics/gpu-pending/ap-southeast1
Carla: Copying runbook steps and notes into the ticket; will add steps to disable prebind quickly per-region.
Dmitri: Closing thread for now. Reopen if counts climb back above 50. :thumbsup:
